title: Analyst, Cluster Head- Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cluster Business Ownership
* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.
* Sales Leadership and Channel Execution
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.
* Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.
* Solution-Led Cross-Sell
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.
* Customer Relationship and Service Governance
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.
* Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.
* People Leadership
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

Key Performance IndicatorsDimensionIllustrative KPIsAcquisitionNew-to-bank current accounts, high-value accounts, segment-wise acquisitionBalance GrowthAQB/AMB growth, activated accounts, value build-up and balance retentionTransaction PrimacyInward credits, transaction-active accounts and payment/collection volumesRevenueFee income, POS/QR revenue, cash-management revenue and cross-sell revenueProduct PenetrationInternet banking, POS, debit/business card, FFD, assets and promoter bankingPortfolio QualityNon-activation rate, dormant accounts, early attrition, balance decline and compliance exceptionsTeam PerformanceProductivity per RM, conversion rate, hiring quality, attrition and training completionCustomer ExperienceOnboarding TAT, service-resolution TAT, complaint trends and retention of top accounts
  
  
**Location:**
Regional Office Coimbatore
  
  
**Job:**
Relationship Management
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time

title: Proposal Engineer
description:
*Hydro Prokav Pumps India Pvt Ltd*
*Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu*
**About Us**
*Hydro Prokav Pumps, part of Ingersoll Rand, a leading progressive cavity pump (PCP) manufacturer and exporter headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Hydro Prokav core expertise lies in PCP solutions, the perfect choice for handling tough, viscous, abrasive, and high-consistency mediums. Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and testing facilities, our integrated plant ensures precision manufacturing and rigorous quality control for every pump produced.*
**Job Summary**

This position will be responsible for product selection, quotes, tendering and order acquisition activities by closely working with customers, sales team, operations and other stakeholders in fulfilling booking targets.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Interpret enquiries and requests for quotations from existing and prospective customers to establish an initial understanding of the customer’s requirements.
* Build further understanding of requirements by liaising with customers.
* In line with product decision, determine the key objectives and possible options to be covered in the proposal, coordinating the supply of necessary information, organizing the various estimates, and defining the scope of supply.
* Reviewing the project specifications to arrive at the complete technical requirements of the customer.
* Work in partnership with Engineering, Commercial and Project Managers as appropriate to need to evaluate technical risk and commercial terms.
* Prepare RFQ’s for suppliers/subcontractors against specs and T&C’s
* Compile comprehensive tender specifications defining prices, commercial conditions, comments and deviations and technical specifications for presentation to the customer.
* Support Sales Manager/Sector Managers /Sales Engineers during the bid-process.
* Act as focal point for customer queries regarding Proposal submission, to reach agreement and build a positive on-going relationship.
* Monitor progress and status of Proposals, maintaining accurate records and keeping the Proposals Manager fully always informed.
* Support Project team during handover of Proposals that have resulted in orders.
* Maintain internal Quality systems as relevant to the processing of enquiries and proposals.
* Ensure that Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality management policies and procedures are adhered to in all work undertaken

**Basic Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field required
* Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in proposals and estimation, preferably in similar industrial products
* Chemical compatibility knowledge

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Drives results and takes initiatives to achieve goals
* Good relationship builder with ability to merge different groups of people, processes and tools
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco

*Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork*
.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
  
  
The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.

**Capacity, Utilization & Workforce Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity-related information as requested by management.

**Coordination & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.

**Process & Administrative Support**

* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

**Core Competencies**
Resource Coordination
  
  
Relationship Management
  
  
Schedule Management
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Capacity Planning & Tracking
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.

* Unix/Linux shell scripting experience.
* Understanding of enterprise integration frameworks, APIs, XML, MQ, and messaging technologies.

* Strong communication and client-facing consulting skills.
* Ability to independently manage workstreams and mentor junior consultants.

* Experience with market infrastructure and utility platforms such as SWIFT, DTCC, Omgeo CTM, Traiana, MarkitSERV, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of valuation, pricing, risk management, VaR, P&L, and treasury operations workflows.

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Revanza Developers is a real estate development company based in Tamil Nadu, specializing in thoughtfully planned residential communities. The organization focuses on quality construction, transparent processes, and innovative design to deliver homes that meet modern lifestyle needs. Projects are strategically located to offer convenient access, strong infrastructure, and long-term value for residents and investors. With an emphasis on sustainable planning and customer-centric development, Revanza Developers aims to build communities that foster comfort, trust, and growth.

Role Overview

We are looking for a customer-focused CRM Manager to manage the complete post-sales customer journey—from plot booking and payment collection to documentation, registration, and handover. The role requires strong coordination with sales, accounts, legal, and project teams to deliver a smooth customer experience and timely completion of commitments.

Key Responsibilities

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary contact for customers after booking and ensure a smooth handover from the sales team.
* Explain payment schedules, documentation requirements, registration procedures, and project updates clearly.
* Handle customer queries, complaints, and escalations with timely follow-up and closure.
* Build customer relationships that support referrals and repeat purchases.

**Booking and Documentation**

* Verify booking forms, customer KYC, plot details, pricing, discounts, and approved payment terms.
* Coordinate allotment letters, sale agreements, payment receipts, and other customer documents.
* Maintain accurate customer files, plot allocation records, and booking status.
* Process cancellation, refund, transfer, and name-change requests according to company policy and approvals.

**Collections and Account Coordination**

* Track payment schedules, send reminders, and follow up on outstanding amounts.
* Work with accounts to reconcile collections, issue receipts, and resolve payment discrepancies.
* Monitor overdue accounts and escalate payment risks promptly.
* Coordinate home or plot loan documentation with customers and financial institutions.

**Registration and Handover**

* Coordinate with legal teams, customers, banks, and registration support teams to arrange sale deed execution.
* Ensure required documents, payment clearances, and internal approvals are ready before registration.
* Coordinate plot identification, boundary verification, possession documentation, and handover with the project team.
* Track pending commitments and follow through until closure.

**Team Management and Reporting**

* Lead CRM executives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor follow-up quality.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM software and establish clear customer communication processes.
* Prepare reports on bookings, collections, outstanding payments, registrations, cancellations, and complaints.
* Keep customer communications aligned with approved project information and company commitments.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; an MBA is an advantage.
* 5–8 years of experience in real estate CRM or post-sales operations, with experience managing a team.
* Preference for candidates with residential plotted development experience.
* Working knowledge of booking documentation, payment reconciliation, sale agreements, and registration coordination.
* Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and customer-handling skills.
* Proficiency in CRM software, MS Excel, and MIS reporting.
* Fluency in Tamil and English.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and registration offices as required.

Key Performance Indicators

* Collections against agreed payment schedules.
* Reduction in overdue receivables.
* Accuracy and timely completion of customer documentation.
* Registration and handover completion against schedules.
* Customer query resolution time and satisfaction.
* CRM data accuracy and timely reporting.

title: Operations Early Career Entry Program
description:
****Who We Are Looking For****
Our
**Operations Early Career Entry Program is**
designed to develop graduates both technically and professionally towards becoming our future leaders. You’ll learn from some of the most respected highly qualified people in the industry and be supported by individual mentors and development programs.. From day one you will be exploring collaborative and dynamic environment company culture, and you will receive:
  
  

* A structured learning and development program, specific job-related trainings, professional

development and soft skills trainings.
  
  

* A buddy who can offer you their experience, knowledge and guidance throughout your internship.
* Dedicated networking events for the Interns.
* Leadership and business-related sessions with Senior Management.
* Possibility to grow your professional network by joining an Employee Committees include Professional PWN, Families Network, Disability & Inclusion Network, Pride & Friends Network, Environmental Sustainability Network.

**Internship dates**
: January 2027 – July 2027
  
  
You must be available to participate in the program in person, starting from day one and for its full duration and
**you are required to work from the office 5 days a week.**
**Why this role is important to us**
Our Global Delivery Function helps our clients achieve better investment outcomes by serving as the foundation of our organization. We perform all operational functions required to produce the back and middle office products and services that clients have contracted with State Street to provide. Our services include custody, accounting, fund administration, transfer agency, middle office and cash processing services for asset managers, asset owners, alternative investors and insurance companies across the full range of asset classes.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For:****
Participants or Program Participants you will be part of any one of the below department State Street is catering:
  
  
**Fund Accountant**
The Fund Accountant is responsible for calculating the net asset values of funds by processing daily accounting related functions to ensure funds prices are accurate and delivered to the client in a timely fashion. The Fund Accountant is the central point of contact for all accounting support functions and analyzes the information received thereby ensuring any discrepancy is monitored and resolved professionally.
  
  
**Financial Reporting Specialist**
The Financial Reporting Accountant is responsible for preparing financial statements for annual and interim cycle. They also prepare and complete first draft of audited annual and un-audited interim financial statements from trial balance including Profit and Loss Account Balance Sheet Cash Flow Schedule of Investments notes to financial statements.
  
  
**Derivatives Specialist**
The team deals with the complex futures and options processing for the entire European exchange traded derivatives, Centre of Excellence book of business and supplementary business offshored from other State Street sites. The Derivatives Group is the central point of contact for the clearing banks and client service teams on all sites. Other services include some cash instructions and the improvement of processes for recording derivative instruments accurately and efficiently.
  
  
**Financial Accountant**
Financial Accountant performs the accounting processes that may include [but is not limited to]: accounting documents processing, journal processing, payments preparation, account reconciliation preparation and verification of the reports performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Treasury Accountant**
Treasury Accountant performs the treasury processes that may include [but is not limited to]: treasury transactions processing (money market stock market), prepare/approve payments, collateral management/margins, monitor minimum required reserve in national central bank, reconciliation bank accounts (cash positions balance sheet) reports, performing other projects as assigned etc.
  
  
**Transfer Agency Administrator**
Transfer Agency Administrator is responsible for trade processing, investor account maintenance, issue reporting and resolution. You will be responsible for processing investor transaction: review documentation to ensure anti-money laundering documentation has been received and enter subscription on ISS and save documentation on to DMS.
  
  
**Middle Office Administrator**
Middle Office Administrator is responsible for processing trade file submitted by the Fund daily on trade-date, trade-date confirmation (electronic telephonic or hard copy) based upon the trade file transmitted by the Fund and trade details provided by the Fund’s approved counter parties and monitor trade fails with prime brokers counter parties and the Fund including review of prime broker/custodian fail or mismatch of reports.
  
  
**Pricing Administrator**
Pricing Administrator’s role is to assist in the accurate and efficient pricing of a range of securities held by investment funds. The principal tasks of this role is to price exchange traded securities and validation to sources such as Bloomberg Reuters and FTID.
  
  
**Risk Analyst**
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) division within State Street Corporation establishes and maintains appropriate risk management policies guidelines and limits and assists executive and business-level management with minimizing operational credit legal regulatory reputation and other risks to the company.
  
  
**Compliance Analyst**
Investment Compliance Analyst will be responsible for monitoring compliance results on client portfolios related to Regulatory and Investment Manager (IM) mandates. Utilizing State Street’s Investment Compliance & Reporting platform the qualified candidate will complete the research analysis and reporting to ensure portfolios are in compliance with their investment restrictions.
  
  
**Data Management Analyst**
The Data Analyst(s) will be responsible to work comprehensively with both IT and the Investment Compliance/Market, Conformity Business Units to procure data necessary for daily compliance and conformity checks. Furthermore the Data Analyst will be responsible for the update and maintenance of market data, static data and holdings data that is not otherwise fed to the core application MIG 21 via automated data feeds.
  
  
**Anti-Money Laundering Specialist**
Anti-Money Laundering Specialist will be involved in reviewing investor Anti Money Laundering documentation in line with the AML policies and liaising with the Transfer Agency team’s in order to request and obtain the required data from the investors and/or clients.
  
  
****What We Value****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Combination of academic aptitude, analytical capabilities, and excellent communication.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving and decision-making skills.
* Display a culture of individual ownership of tasks to embed a clear individual sense of accountability in performing the role.
* Ensure that the highest level of the Code of Conduct is displayed in your behavior.
* Support the ‘Risk Excellence’ culture within the business.
* Adhere to limits of delegation and escalation procedures required by your manager so that you comply with internal policies and external regulations.
* Desire to develop Your career in finance industry.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Basic knowledge in MS Office.

****Education & Preferred Qualifications****

* Final Year Students Enrolled in full time education at undergraduates in the penultimate year of degree in one of the following areas: Finance, Accounting, or Economics are preferred; applicants from other disciplines may also apply.
* Enthusiastic about building a long-term career in a dynamic organization.
* Effective communicators with the ability to collaborate in a team-oriented environment.
* Open to feedback and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Motivated by real-world problem solving and eager to contribute innovative ideas.

****About State Street****
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance, and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Commercial Accountant – E-commerce Vendor Finance (Coimbatore)**

RIK Industries Pvt. Ltd. (About Space brand) manufactures flat-pack furniture at our plant in Karumathampatti, Coimbatore, and sells primarily through Amazon Vendor Central, Flipkart and B2B accounts. We are a 130-plus person company with our own CNC production, packing and dispatch. We are hiring a Commercial Accountant to own margin, receivables and management reporting, leading accounts team. This role reports directly to the Managing Director.

**What you will do**

* Verify cost prices on Amazon Vendor Central against our approved price list for every PO, per ASIN, and flag any drift
* Audit all Amazon deductions — CoOp, COGS discounts, shortage claims, price claims, chargebacks — against agreements; maintain a deduction register per PO and dispute what is not due
* Enter GRNs against marketplace receipts and reconcile dispatched vs received vs paid
* Manage receivables with our Amazon vendor partner and other customers: ageing, follow-up, credit notes, reconciliation of statements
* Set up and run marketplace accounting for direct selling (Amazon Seller Central / Flipkart Seller Hub) as and when we expand — settlement reconciliation, fee and commission verification, FBA inventory and reimbursement claims, GST on marketplace sales.
* Reconcile opening stock, production, dispatch and closing stock every month; attend the quarterly physical count
* Build the monthly management P&L from the closed trial balance: revenue and margin by channel and by SKU after deductions, overheads, cash flow — presented to the MD by the 10th of each month
* Supervise the Accounts Executive, review the monthly close, and own the compliance calendar
* Support costing for new SKUs and B2B quotations

**What we are looking for**

* B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter with 4–8 years in accounts, including at least 2 years handling Amazon or Flipkart accounts on the seller/manufacturer side — Vendor Central required, Seller Central experience a strong plus.
* Strong Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations of large statements); Tally Prime working knowledge
* Understands e-commerce vendor terms — CoOp, COGS, chargebacks, returns, credit notes
* Analytical and persistent; comfortable disputing deductions and chasing collections
* Tamil preferred; good English for email, portals and vendor correspondence
* Based in or willing to relocate to Coimbatore; on-site role

**What we offer**

* ₹50,000 – ₹55,000 per month, depending on experience and qualification
* Additional ₹5,000 per month relocation allowance for candidates moving from outside Coimbatore
* Six-day week, 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM
* Canteen on site.

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director and full ownership of margin and reporting.

* Maintain vendor, customer and ledger masters
* Close the books to a clean trial balance by the 7th of each month
* Prepare workings for statutory audit, tax audit and any GST or income-tax notices with our CA firm
* Handle the books of a second group entity (smaller volume)
* Coordinate with purchase, stores and dispatch teams on bills, GRNs and dispatch documents

* B.Com / M.Com with 3–5 years in a manufacturing company
* Hands-on Tally Prime, GST returns, e-way bill and e-invoice portals
* Comfortable with Excel and with learning new software — we use Chirix (ERP) and Pazy (AP automation)
* Organised, deadline-driven, and able to work with production and dispatch teams on the floor
* Tamil required; working English for email and portals
* Based in or willing to relocate to Coimbatore; on-site role

**What we offer**

* ₹30,000 – ₹35,000 per month, depending on experience
* Additional ₹4,000 per month relocation allowance for candidates moving from outside Coimbatore
* Six-day week, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM
* Canteen on site; accommodation available for outstation candidates

Reports to the Commercial Accountant.

title: Bank Reconciliation Specialist
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* The Bank Reconciliation Specialist is responsible for performing the initial steps in the payment posting process. Daily assignments are provided by the supervisor, and the specialist must develop a plan to complete assigned worklists by the end of each day. The Bank Reconciliation Specialist must comply with applicable billing standards and operate effectively in a team-oriented environment, delivering superior service to providers across the country.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Create monthly reconciliations for individual clients. (Monthly)
* Log into bank portals to download bank statements using Month-to-Date filtering and save them to the designated client folder for the current month. (Daily)
* Download Lockbox and Correspondence files. (Daily)
* Rename Lockbox and Correspondence files according to standard file naming conventions and upload them to the document management system. (Daily)
* Input new daily deposit totals from the previous business day for dashboard reporting. (Daily)
* Place prior day deposits on the client's monthly reconciliation log. (Daily)
* Update post logs daily for current and prior month reconciliations to ensure alignment with the bank statements. (Daily)
* Research and upload any missing remits for posting. (Daily)
* Investigate and resolve posting variances found in the bank statement. (Daily/Weekly)
* Perform daily checks to identify any remits not posted within 3 days and coordinate with the posting team for timely completion. (Daily/Weekly)
* Investigate and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve any variances identified in the reconciliation logs. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Monitor daily ERA checks to ensure they are posting automatically; notify the supervisor if any ERAs are not being received. (Daily/Weekly)
* Provide insurance and check details for ERA setups when necessary. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Review and compare reported deposits against Bank Statement totals to verify that all data is accurate, reconciled, and up-to-date. (Weekly)
* Identify Ventra and Non-Ventra payments.
* Ensure all daily, weekly, and monthly tasks are completed accurately and do not require rework or cross-checking. (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* High School Diploma or GED.
* At least one (1) year of experience reconciling bank account deposits.
* Knowledge of payor portals is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Ability to read, understand, and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast paced environment.
* Basic use of computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.

* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .

description:

TEKSHEI offers opportunities to work closely with cross-functional teams and gain exposure to core business and finance activities. The company values integrity, accountability, and a collaborative work culture while encouraging employees to develop practical skills and grow professionally.

description:
**Job Title: Software Asset Manager / Application Portfolio Lead**

**Job Location: Coimbatore, India**

**Summary**

The Software Asset Manager / Application Portfolio Lead will establish and govern a consolidated view of the client’s engineering, quality, laboratory, analytics, collaboration, and cloud software ecosystem. The role will coordinate software inventory, licensing and renewals, application overlap assessment, usage and cost optimization, governance, and rationalization planning. The portfolio includes tools such
**as LabVantage, EtQ, Compliance Builder, Accuris, Windchill, Agile, Trovaré, Creo, SolidWorks, NX CAD, LabVIEW, Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, SharePoint, Smartsheet, Mural, and AWS S3**
. The role coordinates decisions and implementation with application owners and accountable IT, Engineering, Quality, Security, Procurement, Finance, and Validation stakeholders; it does not replace their technical or approval authority.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain an application inventory with ownership, purpose, users, lifecycle, dependencies, and support information.
* Track software licenses, subscriptions, contracts, vendor support, usage, and renewal dates.
* Review license utilization and validate potential unused, underused, or duplicate licenses.
* Assess application overlap and document options to retain, optimize, consolidate, replace, or retire applications.
* Coordinate a consolidation roadmap with priorities, owners, dependencies, milestones, and risks.
* Track software costs, approved optimization actions, and validated benefits.
* Coordinate portfolio reviews, decision logs, action trackers, and escalations.
* Coordinate applicable security, privacy, validation, change-control, and records-retention reviews with accountable teams.
* Prepare dashboards and reports on inventory, utilization, renewals, costs, risks, and roadmap progress.

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
* Typically 5+ years of experience in software asset management, application portfolio management, IT service management, software licensing, procurement operations, or technology governance.
* Experience with application inventories, license registers, contract and renewal trackers, and management reporting.
* Knowledge of software licensing, subscriptions, vendor contracts, usage reporting, and total cost of ownership.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI or similar reporting tools preferred.
* Familiarity with SAM/ITAM, CMDB, ITSM, contract-management, or procurement platforms is preferred.
* Experience in MedTech, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or another regulated industry is an advantage.
* Familiarity with validation, change control, data integrity, cybersecurity, or records retention is beneficial.

**Service line - Position Title:**

**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency - Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk & Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
  
  
In this role we are looking for an experienced
**SAP FI Senior Consultant**
to join our growing SAP Finance team. In this role, you will lead and support SAP FI design, configuration, and implementation activities across a range of projects. You will work closely with business stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions within the SAP FI landscape
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* The primary function of this position is to work as a team member in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively to the area of SAP FI General Ledger, Accounts Payables, Accounts receivable, Bank Accounting Taxation, and Fixed Assets functionalities with a preferred background in the relevant industry.
* The Specialist will work in the implementation of all the above modules as part of the S4HANA Finance Transformation project, ensuring seamless integration with other third‑party systems.
* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the manager/lead

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**

* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
* Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow‑up on the action items from the workshops
* Knowledge of SAP – BPC (Consolidation), Special purpose ledger, SOX, US GAAP, Various of Exits, Background on the Technical and Functional upgrade, Report painter, Report writer etc.
* Experience on FIORI APPS, BO-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools.
* Prior client facing consulting experience.
* SAP Finance/Controlling Certification is a plus

**What We Look For**

* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 3-7 years
* Experience should be in End-to-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.


+ SAP Finance – FI- New General Ledger & Profit Center Accounting, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
+ Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling & Profitability Analysis.
+ SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
+ SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
+ Controlling- CO-Cost element accounting CO-Cost Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.
+ Knowledge on CO-PA & Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling).
+ FI integration with MM, SD, HR & PS.
+ Excellent business communication skills

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Company Description**

The Indirect Tax Associate will handle GST compliance for clients of S P V S & Co., Chartered Accountants across different industries. * CA Inter, or a graduate in commerce (B.Com, BBA or a related discipline) with experience in an auditor’s office.
* Exposure to GST return filing, annual returns or replies to GST notices.
* Working knowledge of the GST portal and basic GST concepts.
* Good Excel skills, including lookups, filters and pivot tables.
* Exposure to Tally and ERP packages.
* Good written and spoken communication in English and Tamil.
* Attention to detail and the ability to meet due dates across several clients.
* Willingness to learn and adapt.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and interpretation skills for complex tax issues.
* Ability to communicate clearly with clients and team members and to present technical information effectively.
* Attention to detail, high ethical standards, and the ability to manage multiple engagements and deadlines.

title: Manager - Tax – Internal Tax Operations
description:
**Position Profile**
Weaver is looking for talented tax manager to join our growing firm! The Internal Tax Operations team supports the tax-related activity of Weaver and its partners. This includes the firm’s partnership return, state and international tax compliance, and individual partner tax returns.

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams

**Additionally, The Following Qualifications Are Preferred**

* Master’s degree in accounting or related field
* Experience with multi-state tax compliance
* Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff

title: Chartered Accountant
description:
**Company Description**

CtrlSphere Digital Technologies creates tailored digital solutions for mental-health professionals, including psychologists, therapists, counsellors, and mental-health practices. The company focuses on building professional and meaningful online presences through website design, branding, content, and technology that reflect each practice’s values and work. CtrlSphere combines technology, creativity, and industry-specific insight to develop digital tools, automation, and AI-powered solutions for this community. Its services span web development, digital strategy, social media, and creative solutions, all aimed at supporting mental-health professionals at every stage of their online journey. The vision is to grow a digital ecosystem where impactful mental-health work is visible and accessible.

**Role Description**

This is a remote, contract role for a Chartered Accountant supporting CtrlSphere’s financial planning and compliance activities. The Chartered Accountant will handle day-to-day accounting operations, including bookkeeping, general ledger maintenance, accounts payable and receivable, and bank reconciliations. The role involves preparing financial statements, budgeting and forecasting reports, cash flow analyses, and management accounts, as well as monitoring project and client profitability. The Chartered Accountant will ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and reporting requirements, and will coordinate with external auditors where needed. This role also includes advising leadership on financial performance, developing internal controls, and supporting process improvements to help the company scale sustainably.

**Qualifications**

* Strong financial accounting and reporting skills, including experience with general ledger management, financial statements preparation, and monthly/quarterly closing.
* Proficiency in management accounting and analysis, such as budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cash flow management.
* Solid knowledge of taxation and compliance, including corporate tax, GST/VAT (or equivalent), and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Experience with accounting and finance software tools, spreadsheets, and cloud-based systems; ability to work efficiently in a digital-first environment.
* Recognized Chartered Accountant qualification (e.g., CA, CPA, ACCA) and a strong understanding of relevant accounting standards.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to collaborate remotely across multidisciplinary teams.
* Prior experience in a technology, digital services, or professional services environment is an advantage.
* Capacity to work independently, manage deadlines for multiple projects, and maintain high ethical and professional standards.

title: Independent Director
description:
**The Chair must understand what happens between the gate and the accounts**

This is a process-manufacturing mandate in which yield, grade, energy, water, effluent, maintenance, working capital and export execution all have financial consequences. The Board seeks a director capable of walking a plant, questioning the control design at source and later recognising the same issue in margin, provisions, cash flow and risk disclosure.

The dual chairship matters. Audit can identify recurring inventory, quality, safety or compliance issues; NRC must then ask whether accountabilities, capability, incentives and succession are helping or preventing durable correction. The director should resist the habit of treating people questions as separate from control quality.

**A plant-to-board agenda**

The first operating review should begin with material flow. The Chair will test purchase specifications, receipt controls, consumption norms, yield variance, rework, scrap, by-product accounting and finished-goods valuation. Variances should be understood by cause and recurrence, not merely absorbed into standard cost. Slow-moving and customer-specific inventory needs evidence-based provisioning.

The second lens is resource and process integrity. Water withdrawal, effluent treatment, emissions, chemical handling, energy intensity and waste are not solely ESG disclosures; they affect licence to operate, capital needs, contingent liability and customer acceptance. The committee should receive exceptions, near misses, consent conditions, monitoring reliability and closure evidence in a form that permits independent challenge.

Export and customer economics form the third lens. Foreign-exchange exposure, quality claims, shipment cut-off, rebates, customer concentration, logistics disruption and receivable recoverability should be reconciled to contract terms and cash. The Board needs to know when commercial accommodation becomes an accounting estimate or a conduct concern.

Maintenance and capex are the fourth. Deferred maintenance can flatter cash while increasing downtime, safety and quality risk. Each material capital project should have a baseline covering output, yield, resource intensity, safety and return; post-completion reviews should separate installation from realised benefit.

**NRC work that follows the evidence**

The appointee will lead succession planning for plant, commercial, finance and control leadership; review whether site-level managers can escalate bad news without penalty; and examine reward measures that may encourage volume at the expense of quality, resource compliance or working capital. A skills and dependency review should identify roles for which retirement, attrition or local knowledge loss would interrupt safe operation.

**The candidate**

Applicants may be manufacturing CFOs, plant or business heads, audit professionals, risk leaders or former chief executives with direct process-industry responsibility. They must show personal engagement with plant economics and control—not only corporate reporting. Experience of environmental compliance, export operations, labour-intensive sites or turnaround assurance is valuable. Previous Audit Committee chairship is preferred for the dual-chair role.

The appointment is conditional on independence checks, DIN and Independent Directors' Databank requirements. The Chair should expect site visits in addition to regular Board and committee meetings, with extra engagement around annual accounts, a material incident or leadership transition.

title: Associate - Accounting
description:
As an
 **Accounting Analyst** 
 , you will support day\-to\-day accounting operations and monthly financial close activities, with a strong focus on accuracy, timeliness, compliance, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will work closely with finance teams and other internal stakeholders to prepare and review accounting entries, perform reconciliations, investigate variances, resolve queries, and maintain supporting documentation. You will also have opportunities to identify process gaps and use tools such as Excel, Power Automate, macros, or robotic process automation to improve accounting processes.

 **fresh CA/CMA qualified professional**

* Support month\-end close activities, including preparation, review, and processing of journal entries within agreed timelines.

* Identify accounting or process issues, perform initial root\-cause analysis, and support development of corrective actions.

* Collaborate effectively with finance teams and other internal stakeholders across locations to resolve accounting queries and support smooth process transitions.
* Maintain appropriate documentation, supporting evidence, and accounting rationale to ensure audit readiness and compliance with internal controls.
* Complete mandatory corporate, finance, and compliance training within required timelines.
* Identify inefficiencies and opportunities to simplify accounting workflows and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

* Freshly qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost and Management Accountant (CMA).
* Strong understanding of financial accounting principles, journal entries, general ledger accounting, account reconciliations, and financial statements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Ability to manage multiple activities and work effectively within monthly reporting deadlines.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders and finance teams across different locations.
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to learn.


**Preferred**
* Exposure to month\-end close, financial reporting, audit, taxation, reconciliations, or general ledger accounting through articleship, internship, industrial training, or similar practical experience.
* Exposure to ERP/accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with process automation tools such as Power Automate, Excel macros, or RPA.
* Interest in process improvement, automation, and working in a shared\-services or global finance environment

description:

title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Strategic Sourcing
description:
Key Responsibilities
   




- Sourcing \& Supplier Development

* Identify and develop new suppliers for mechanical components.
* Source components such as machined parts, sheet metal components, fabricated parts, castings, forgings, turned components, laser\-cut parts, and other precision mechanical components.
* Evaluate suppliers based on capability, quality, cost, capacity, and delivery performance.
* Develop alternate sources to improve competitiveness and supply continuity.
* Optimising the Cost, Quality and Delivery.
* Factory RM Purchase
* Maintain supplier relationship.


- Costing \& Cost Analysis

* Prepare should\-cost / target\-cost estimates for mechanical components.
* Analyse drawings, BOMs, specifications, and manufacturing requirements to arrive at component costing.
* Understand and calculate costs related to:
+ Raw material
+ Machining
+ Turning / milling
+ Fabrication
+ Sheet metal processing
+ Labour and overheads

* Benchmark supplier quotations against calculated costs and negotiate accordingly.
* Identify cost\-reduction opportunities through VA/VE, process optimization, material alternatives, and supplier development.


- Technical Evaluation

* Read and understand 2D mechanical drawings, GD\&T, material specifications, and BOMs.
* Discuss manufacturing feasibility and costing with suppliers.
* Work closely with Engineering, Quality, Production, and Design teams for new component development.
* Evaluate supplier process capabilities and manufacturing methods.


- Quotation \& Commercial Negotiation

* Obtain and analyse techno\-commercial quotations from suppliers.
* Prepare comparative statements and negotiate price, tooling, MOQ, payment terms, lead time, and delivery conditions.
* Ensure purchases are made at competitive and technically justified prices.


- New Product / Component Development

* Support sourcing activities for new products and engineering changes.
* Coordinate with suppliers for prototype/sample development.
* Track sample submission, approval, and transition to regular production.


- Cost Reduction \& Continuous Improvement

* Identify opportunities for annual cost savings.
* Conduct supplier negotiations based on cost breakdown and market benchmarks.
* Develop alternate suppliers and alternate manufacturing processes wherever feasible.



  

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


 Required Experience \& Skills
   




* Mechanical Engineering graduate with 4 years of experience in Mechanical Sourcing / Strategic Procurement / Purchase.
* Experience in sourcing mechanical components from manufacturing suppliers.
* Strong understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and raw materials.
* Ability to work out component costing from drawings and manufacturing processes.
* Good knowledge of cost estimation / should\-costing / target costing.
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and BOMs.
* Strong supplier development and negotiation skills.
* Experience in identifying alternate suppliers and developing new sources.
* Good analytical and commercial skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel; experience with ERP systems
* Knowledge of Tamil is must.



  

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  

 PF \& ESI and other Insurance benefits

title: Costing & Estimation Engineer – Fabrication
description:
**We’re Hiring \| Costing \& Estimation Engineer – Fabrication** 




 NRC Groups is looking for an experienced Costing \& Estimation Engineer to prepare accurate estimates and competitive quotations for fabrication projects.
 



**Experience:** 
 Minimum 5 years in fabrication costing and estimation
 



**Number of openings:** 
 1
 



**Location:** 
 Coimbatore
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 You will review engineering drawings and customer specifications to estimate costs for mild steel (MS) and stainless steel (SS) fabrication, including pressure vessels, storage tanks, structural fabrication and process equipment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Prepare detailed cost estimates, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), material requirements and quotations.
* Calculate material, labour, fabrication, machining, welding, surface treatment and subcontracting costs.
* Review drawings and technical specifications to identify scope gaps and clarify requirements before quoting.
* Coordinate with design, production and procurement teams to validate costs and manufacturing feasibility.
* Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and support technical and commercial discussions.
* Prepare costing inputs for tenders and proposals within required deadlines.
* Maintain costing records, update material and process rates, and compare estimated costs with actual project costs.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 



* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in fabrication costing and estimation.
* Sound knowledge of MS/SS materials, fabrication methods, welding and machining processes.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications and P\&IDs.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and estimation tools.
* Familiarity with applicable fabrication codes and standards, including ASME and IS.
* Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, communication and coordination skills.



  





**To Apply** 




 Send your CV to
 **sreekumar@nrcgroups.com** 
 with the subject line
 **“Application – Costing \& Estimation Engineer.”**
